decisive_items: directed an online-bought handheld high-intensity LED light at her right eye multiple times at very short distance with flash mode
disruption of ellipsoid zone, outer segment photoreceptor and interdigitation zone
Mosaic-like hyporeflective outer retinal space with flat RPE
response.rationale: The exposure history, outer retinal OCT changes, and serial improvement are most consistent with phototoxic maculopathy specifically induced by high-intensity LED light.

rejected.why: Solar retinopathy is a phototoxic retinopathy but requires direct sun exposure; this case involves LED light, making phototoxic maculopathy the more precise label.
Photoreceptor damage is the pathophysiologic consequence rather than the specific clinical diagnosis and lacks the etiologic specificity of phototoxic maculopathy.
